sections.title: Ten blockers to clear before release
Every feature, and where it stands

overview.intro:
Deco Blocks is the next major version of Deco's framework, which ships today as the @decocms 7.x packages. The API in these docs is proposed and hasn't shipped yet; this page is the to-do list for releasing it (a release of the framework, not to be confused with content releases). To build it, we checked the proposed API feature by feature against three real sites that will move to it: a TanStack storefront on the current packages, a TanStack blog on an older package, and a Next.js storefront on another CMS.

No site can move using only what these docs describe. Each first needs something missing: Studio support, a way for blocks to read the current request, or SDK functions beyond the CMS. The ten release blockers gate the release; the status of every feature the three sites use is under Release readiness.
overview.readiness_lead: None of the 111 features those sites use is done yet: 11 are still to build, 66 are to finish, 28 are left to site code, and 6 go away with the migration.
overview.fix_docs: Fix the docs A few statements in these docs still disagree. Schema generation says the CMS never sees Content, while the API reference says list also matches aliases of a type, which for a Content type only the CLI knows. The fixes are the first two docs work items: {{item:roadmap-docs--resolve-contradictions-in-these-docs}} and {{item:roadmap-docs--correct-studio-compatibility}}.

blockers.title: Let Studio talk to a next-major site
blockers.today: Nothing serves /live/_meta, /.decofile, /live/previews, /deco/invoke or the secrets encrypt action, and Studio's code contradicts the claim in Studio compatibility that it only reads the schema and files.
blockers.plan: Ship createStudioHandler({ cms, schema, render }) in @decocms/blocks-admin, mounted in one line per binding, and correct Studio compatibility.

blockers.title: Make the CLI write a schema Studio can read
blockers.today: The CLI writes .deco/schema.json with top-level definitions; Studio reads .deco/meta.gen.json in LiveMeta shape (btoa keys, schema.root). There are no apps or actions groups, no per-type variant definitions, and the widget vocabulary is undocumented, so 22 image pickers would become text inputs and HTML fields plain strings.
blockers.plan: Emit Studio's exact file and shape, add apps/actions groups and one multivariate definition per VariantOf<T>, publish the JSDoc/@format table, and keep widget-alias detection and return-type loader unions.

blockers.title: Give blocks the page URL and route params
blockers.today: On SPA navigation getRequest() returns the /_serverFn URL, Next's headers() has no URL, app packages' loaders have no standard way to receive the URL or match.params, and apps-vtex's RequestContext is never populated.
blockers.plan: Add one binding-owned request scope (url, params, request, client, response headers) that both bindings' openPage populate and apps can import.

blockers.title: Make draft preview work inside Studio's iframe
blockers.today: The SameSite=Lax cookie is rejected cross-site, the TanStack guide never sets it, and ?__draft=off is ignored. There's no no-store rule, and no StudioBridge or data-manifest-key, so click-to-select is lost.
blockers.plan: Ship withDeco()/decoProxy(), which set the cookie as Secure; SameSite=None; Partitioned, treat off/empty as exit and mark drafts private/no-store. Add <StudioBridge/>, and have <BlockList> emit Studio's section[data-manifest-key] marker.

blockers.title: Define the non-CMS SDK surface
blockers.today: apps-* and the ClickHouse telemetry depend on sdk/requestContext, instrumentedFetch, fetchCache and cachedLoader, and sites' widgets on sdk/useDevice and the Image and JsonLd hooks. These docs only list 'loaders, client, resolution, router'.
blockers.plan: Publish a 7.x-to-next surface map, keep sdk/* as a documented utility tier, and ship @decocms/blocks/image.
blockers.delivered_note: No work item covers the 7.x-to-next surface map yet.

blockers.title: Add a revision handle, an edge cache kit and an ISR recipe
blockers.today: Clients expose no revision and there's no forRevision. Degraded pages get cached. The planned check for a new release runs once a minute, at an idle moment (inside ctx.waitUntil on Workers), so a publish is live everywhere within about a minute; a cold isolate serves the content module it was deployed with until its first check.
blockers.plan: Add a revision handle, a way to read and pin the revision a client serves (client.revision(), cms.forRevision(), onUpdate), and markDegraded(). Add an edge cache kit, withEdgeCache() in @decocms/tanstack, for caching rendered pages at the edge, and an ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration: re-rendering cached pages in the background) recipe for Next.js.

blockers.title: Stop resolving everything eagerly
blockers.today: The one registry rule resolves inputs bottom-up. Lazy defers nothing (43 wrappers on the storefront), hidden variants still run their loaders, and Resolved<T> can't be expressed.
blockers.plan: Add one deferral API: a Deferred<T> input type bound to the client's revision, which <BlockList> renders lazily. A multivariate over Deferred values resolves only the winner.

blockers.title: Make the next major load and resolve legacy content
blockers.today: Filename decoding is unspecified, and the alias bridge covers only pages, matchers and multivariate, while Studio writes Lazy, SeoV2, site/apps/site.ts, redirect, secret and the multi matcher. UNKNOWN_BLOCK now fails the parent block, and list() can't see Content aliases.
blockers.plan: Specify single-decode filenames, widen the alias bridge, ship deco check and deco content, and have the CLI emit a runtime alias table.

blockers.title: Make routing accept the content sites already store
blockers.today: There's no splat, so /* PLPs never match. matchRoute throws per request on an ambiguity a single Studio commit can introduce. Page.seo is required but content stores null, and with no 404 gate unknown URLs return soft 200s.
blockers.plan: Add a trailing splat and make matchRoute non-throwing, with release-time validation. Make seo optional and add a critical-block notFound/redirect sentinel.

blockers.title: Define a model for apps, config and secrets
blockers.today: App loaders get no config, there's no apps manifest group, website/loaders/secret.ts can't decrypt, and without the site's encrypt action Studio refuses to save any Secret field.
blockers.plan: Define an app contract (blocks, Config, configure()), plus @decocms/blocks/secrets (the secret block and the site-side encrypt action) and an apps group.

studio_new.title: Give Studio a schema it can read, so the editor loads
studio_new.today: Studio reads .deco/meta.gen.json or /live/_meta in LiveMeta shape, so a next-major site shows 'live meta unavailable'.

studio_new.title: Keep gallery, theme and in-place previews working
studio_new.today: Studio's section thumbnails (its legacy name for block previews), global and theme previews, and Fast Preview in-place render all go through /live/previews.

studio_new.title: Require a draft grant for in-place preview renders
studio_new.today: The proposed Studio handler doesn't define who may request an in-place render.

studio_new.title: Let editors save Secret fields on next-major sites
studio_new.today: Studio encrypts Secret fields through an encrypt action the site serves. On a next-major site without that action, editors can't save any Secret field.

studio_new.title: Keep @options, Run and pickers working
studio_new.today: These need /deco/invoke and /live/invoke. The blog ProductShelf picker even calls production's /deco/invoke with legacy VTEX keys.

studio_new.title: Restore click-to-select
studio_new.today: There's no editor::inject listener, and the guides' renderers emit no Studio section[data-manifest-key] marker.

studio_new.title: Keep the draft past the first in-frame click
studio_new.today: The Lax cookie isn't stored cross-site and the TanStack guide never sets it. ?__draft=off can leave a stale draft behind.

studio_new.title: Give field-level variants a schema contract
studio_new.today: Studio's field variant UI needs a single-option block-ref whose definition has variants, and takes the inner field from variants.items.properties.value, else a plain string (schema-form.tsx:76-87, 254-280). The proposed API's one generic multivariate<T> and VariantOf<T> give the CLI no concrete T. Legacy schemas had one flag per kind, e.g. website/flags/multivariate/image.ts.

studio_new.title: Keep variant tabs and the device toggle working
studio_new.today: x-deco-matchers-override and ?deviceHint have no reader in an app-owned multivariate.

studio_new.title: Stop Studio reading short type names as saved entries
studio_new.today: Studio classifies keys by file extension, so a site's UI blocks must keep legacy site/sections/X.tsx keys until it does a manifest lookup.

studio_new.title: Prevent entry names from colliding with types
studio_new.today: Studio's only write guard rejects keys with a source-file extension (block-key.ts:48-50). An editor can save an entry named hero, seo or page; under the proposed API's { ...savedEntries, ...blocks } the function wins and the entry is silently ignored. Only deco schema in CI catches it, after the commit is on the production branch.

studio_new.title: Let Studio see and edit flat redirect entries
studio_new.today: The Redirects collection lists only blocks typed exactly website/loaders/redirect.ts and writes { redirect: { from, to, type, discardQueryParameters } }, with temporary = 307 (redirect-data.ts:14,29-32,77). Flat redirect entries written by developers or agents never appear there and can't be edited.

studio_new.title: Fix local and tunnel modes; show local edits in dev
studio_new.today: The dev server serves neither endpoint. With a token in .dev.vars, remoteLoader swaps in the production release over local edits.

studio_new.title: Speed up publishes and make failures visible
studio_new.today: The planned once-a-minute check makes a publish live within about a minute, but nothing tells the editor when it is live. A failed forDraft silently shows published content.

studio_new.title: Keep experiments working on next-major sites
studio_new.today: Results are keyed on the random matcher's saved-entry name, which a pure block function never sees.

studio_legacy.title: Handle the legacy types Studio keeps writing
studio_legacy.today: website/pages/Page.tsx, SeoV2 on every new page, Rendering/Lazy.tsx (the ⚡ toggle), flags/multivariate/section.ts (hide), nested website/loaders/redirect.ts, website/loaders/secret.ts, site/apps/site.ts, the multi matcher, Theme. The bridge only aliases pages, matchers and multivariate, so these Studio actions produce UNKNOWN_BLOCK unless each site registers them.

studio_legacy.title: Stop hidden blocks from running
studio_legacy.today: 'Every variant resolves': a block hidden with a never-rule still runs its loaders, and its undefined renders 'temporarily unavailable'.

studio_legacy.title: Drop hidden array items instead of leaving holes
studio_legacy.today: Studio hides a banner or link by wrapping it in website/flags/multivariate.ts with a never rule (array-item-hidden.ts:35-40). Today's resolver drops undefined array items (resolve.ts:849-860). The proposed API's rule and resolve(page.sections) ('An array of results, one per block in the list') keep them, so components receive undefined entries.

studio_legacy.title: Fix the default-variant rule that makes other variants unreachable
studio_legacy.today: Studio seeds every new variant with an always rule (section-types.ts:26; a new field variant starts as two) and keeps the first always, else the last variant (section-variants.ts:158-168). These docs say 'put the always() variant first as the default' and 'first match wins', which makes every other variant unreachable; their own HomeHero puts always last.

studio_legacy.title: Decode filenames exactly once
studio_legacy.today: Studio writes encodeURIComponent(key). Real stems include pages-Category%2520Page-* and collections%2Fblog%2F*.

studio_legacy.title: Handle short-form pages in the page list and SEO
studio_legacy.today: page entries are missing from the page list and can be mistaken for the site-SEO owner.

studio_legacy.title: Stop keying the Blog tab on legacy names
studio_legacy.today: It looks for blog/loaders/*.ts and @decocms/apps-blog ≥ 7.53.0. The TanStack blog reads as unsupported-runtime today.

studio_legacy.title: Upgrade both TanStack sites so Studio can frame them
studio_legacy.today: Both TanStack sites send X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and lack ?__draft, so both plans start with an upgrade to the latest 7.x, past #390 (7.20.10) and #442 (7.34.0).

studio_legacy.title: Make content drift visible to editors
studio_legacy.today: Fields missing from the schema are hidden, and defaults apply only on save. The storefront's Header children are typed string[] today.

work_items.title: Add a request scope
work_items.plan: One binding-owned scope in @decocms/blocks, behind conditional exports: requestScope() returns { url, params, request, client, device, forcedRules }, plus appendResponseHeader(). Both bindings' openPage populate it with the real page href (port derivePageUrl), match.params and the per-request client. It replaces sdk/requestContext, the page-scope helpers and currentClient(), so apps import one framework-neutral port and content-reading loaders stay revision-pinned. device honors ?deviceHint and forcedRules exposes x-deco-matchers-override, both on drafts only.

work_items.title: Ship the Studio protocol handler
work_items.plan: createStudioHandler({ cms, schema, render }) in blocks-admin serves /live/_meta, /.decofile, /deco/invoke/:key (allowlist, CORS), and POST /live/invoke/website/actions/secrets/encrypt.ts plus the $live/actions/secrets/encrypt.ts key ({ value } → { value: hex }, what Studio's Secret field calls). It also serves /live/previews (framework render callback, request-scoped CMS, preview resolver), the one preview contract for gallery, theme and in-place renders. In-place renders require a draft grant the content API verifies, or a configured preview host.

work_items.title: Let Studio follow the deployed schema
work_items.plan: Studio builds its forms from whichever schema the user points it at, usually the one on the main branch. An option to follow the schema the deployed site serves at /live/_meta would keep editors from adding a block type before the code that defines it is live. Update Schema generation once it ships.

work_items.title: Add a block renderer and a deferral API
work_items.plan: <BlockList> per binding: per-block Suspense, error boundary, clientOnly, sized fallbacks, eager above the fold, SEO routing, and Studio's section[data-manifest-key] frame on every block. One deferral API: a Deferred<T> input type passes a ref bound to the client's revision instead of resolving it. <BlockList> renders the ref lazily, and a multivariate whose values are Deferred<T> resolves only the winning variant.

work_items.title: Ship the withDeco() and decoProxy() entry wrappers
work_items.plan: withDeco(handler, { cms }) (TanStack) and decoProxy() (Next) own the per-request plumbing. They set the draft cookie as Secure; SameSite=None; Partitioned; HttpOnly and treat __draft=off or an empty value as exit. Drafted responses are private/no-store/noindex, and security headers carry frame-ancestors from an exported STUDIO_FRAME_ANCESTORS, never X-Frame-Options. Studio routes are optional. The CMS keys draft caches on the API ETag, bounded by an LRU.

work_items.title: Add a revision handle
work_items.plan: client.revision(), cms.forRevision(rev) / forRelease({ revision }), CMS.onUpdate(cb) and update({ force }).

work_items.title: Keep the utility tier and document it
work_items.plan: Document instrumentedFetch, fetchCache, cached() (cachedLoader), fetchTimeout and recordCommerceMetric as importable by apps, with preview bypass and clear().

work_items.title: Add remoteLoader options
work_items.plan: { interval, coldStartTimeoutMs, channel, onUpdate, onError }, also accepted by createCMS. interval is in milliseconds, defaults to DECO_CONTENT_INTERVAL or 60 000, and has a 60 000 minimum (lower values are raised to one minute with a warning). Each check runs one interval ± 10 s after the previous one and fetches only the revision hash. The SDK schedules due checks itself at an idle moment: requestIdleCallback, then scheduler.postTask, then setTimeout; an unref'd timer on Node; and after the response inside ctx.waitUntil on Workers. Instances are process-wide singletons keyed by configuration, with a resetForTests() helper.

work_items.title: Document and support KV-only content for large Workers sites
work_items.plan: With content plus token, the bundled content module stays in memory as the fallback next to the live release, against a Worker isolate's 128 MB limit, and it also counts toward the script size limit. Document passing a KV-backed Loader as content for large sites, so no copy is bundled and the fallback is read from KV only when needed. Ship a first-party kvLoader(env.CONTENT, { key }), and a documented deploy step that writes the content to the key before the new Worker takes traffic, since with a missing key every new isolate fails its first reads until its first release check.

work_items.title: Add session, region, delivery promise and prices to apps-vtex
work_items.plan: A session module (resolveRegion, setSegment, useVtexSession), delivery promise in the Intelligent Search loaders, tax-inclusive prices, full installments with InterestRate, an invoke-free cart hook, an Intelligent Search events subscriber and createVtexIoClient.

work_items.title: Add a Studio bridge
work_items.plan: A client-safe <StudioBridge /> that accepts editor::inject only from an explicit list of Studio origins, configurable for self-hosted and native Studio. Also resolve(t, { withType: true }) to recover the block type.

work_items.title: Ship an SEO kit in apps-website and apps-commerce
work_items.plan: PageSeo, and SEO functions pre-aliased to SeoV2/Seo/SeoPDPV2/SeoPLPV2. mergeSiteSeo(siteSeo, pageSeo) is the one site-SEO merge, sharing a test suite with Studio. seoToNextMetadata / seoToTanStackHead, JSON-LD builders and a <JsonLd> renderer.

work_items.title: Define an app contract
work_items.plan: Each @decocms/apps-* exports blocks (legacy keys), type Config and configure() from env, with no @decocms/tanstack dependency and no dynamic module import.

work_items.title: Add an edge cache kit
work_items.plan: withEdgeCache(entry, { segment, profiles }) in @decocms/tanstack, keyed by URL, build, revision and segment. It skips drafts, cold-start fallback and degraded pages. Plus cacheHeaders(profile) and markDegraded().

work_items.title: Define a per-client memoization contract
work_items.plan: A saved entry, or an identical inline block, resolves once per client (keyed by type plus canonical inputs), and concurrent calls share in-flight promises.

work_items.title: Add a splat to matchRoute and stop request-time throws
work_items.plan: A trailing /* or /:rest* at lowest precedence (also for Redirect.from, with substitution), a deterministic tie-break that returns a Result, and case-insensitive matching as an option.

work_items.title: Ship @decocms/blocks/secrets
work_items.plan: @decocms/blocks/secrets: a secret block aliased as website/loaders/secret.ts that decrypts with DECO_CRYPTO_KEY, and the encrypt action createStudioHandler serves. Encryption stays on the site, so the key never leaves it. Amend 'the token is the only secret' in Preview.

work_items.title: Add a site-wide layout helper
work_items.plan: mergeGlobals(site, page), with layout blocks resolved on the page's client. Site SEO defaults go through the SEO kit's mergeSiteSeo.

work_items.title: Keep the TanStack router helpers available
work_items.plan: Keep createDecoRouter, or export decoParseSearch/decoStringifySearch and the CSP-nonce wiring.

work_items.title: Add an image module
work_items.plan: @decocms/blocks/image (optimized URLs, srcset, Studio quality params), a Next loaderFile, and TanStack <Image>/<Picture>. Export the widget aliases.

work_items.title: Add an analytics bootstrap and experiment support
work_items.plan: A framework-neutral <DecoAnalytics /> (DECO.events + ANALYTICS_SCRIPT) and a typed useSendEvent/dispatch. An assignExperiments() middleware helper, and a way for random matchers to know their entry name.

work_items.title: Add a not-found and redirect gate before streaming
work_items.plan: A critical block (or seo) may return { notFound } or { redirect }, which the app maps to notFound()/redirect(). Framework control-flow errors are rethrown.

work_items.title: Add observability seams
work_items.plan: A createCMS onEvent/instrument hook, instrumentRequest(handler) outside createDecoWorkerEntry, a Node/Next meter bootstrap and a traced <BlockSlot>.

work_items.title: Add predictive search and shipping rates to apps-shopify
work_items.plan: A predictive-search suggestions loader and a shipping-rates helper.

work_items.title: Generate the sitemap from a client
work_items.plan: sitemapEntries(client, { types, expand, exclude }), keeping toSitemapXml/toSitemapIndex, plus a Shopify sitemap merge.

work_items.title: Give the traffic split a home and bypass drafts by default
work_items.plan: Move withABTesting to @decocms/tanstack/traffic-split and bypass drafts by default.

work_items.title: Write a Studio-compatible schema file
work_items.plan: Write .deco/meta.gen.json in LiveMeta shape: manifest.blocks, schema.definitions keyed by padded, path-independent btoa, and schema.root unions. Add apps and actions groups. For every VariantOf<T> field, emit a monomorphized multivariate definition per T (value typed as T) under Studio's legacy per-kind keys (website/flags/multivariate/section.ts, …/image.ts, …), so the field variant UI renders the right input.

work_items.title: Widen the legacy alias bridge
work_items.plan: Alias Lazy/SingleDeferred/Deferred, Seo*, site/apps/site.ts, resolved, requestToParam, secret, redirect (with shape mapping), the device and random matchers, the multi matcher (website/matchers/multi.ts and $live/matchers/MatchMulti.ts, whose and/or combinators keep the { op, matchers } shape that Studio's variant calendar and rule labels read), Analytics and Theme, and list exactly which paths.

work_items.title: Add validation commands to the CLI
work_items.plan: deco check/validate reporting UNKNOWN_BLOCK, NOT_FOUND, orphans, schema violations and route collisions, with an optional resolve-every-page smoke test.

work_items.title: Add deco schema --check, a compatibility check
work_items.plan: deco schema --check <base> generates the schema, compares it with a base .deco/schema.json (in CI, the one on the target branch), lists every breaking change and exits non-zero if there is one. It writes nothing. Breaking: removing a block type or Content type (any removal, since it compares schemas only), removing or renaming a field, adding a required field or making an optional one required, and narrowing a field's type (a string becoming a union of allowed values, a union losing a member, a tighter limit: a lower @maximum/@maxLength or a higher @minimum/@minLength). Not breaking: adding a type, adding an optional field, widening a type. An alias keeps a renamed type's old name in the schema, so a block type renamed with an alias passes; Content types wait for the runtime alias table. The docs ship a GitHub Actions example. Compatibility is checked here, before merge; the Deco API and remoteLoader don't compare schemas at runtime.

work_items.title: Publish the tag and widget vocabulary
work_items.plan: A full JSDoc/@format table (image-uri, video-uri, html, rich-text, rich-text-inline, textarea, markdown, color-input, icon-select, @titleBy, @hide, @options, @label, @minItems…), with widget-alias detection kept, labelled literals, and a golden test against generate-schema.ts.

work_items.title: Ship migration codemods
work_items.plan: deco migrate block-map from 7.x manifests, one 7 → next import codemod (6.x sites upgrade to 7.x first), an SEO-hoist rule, APP_REGISTRY → block maps and a requestToParam scaffold.

work_items.title: Build a FastStore importer
work_items.plan: deco import faststore: VTEX Headless CMS content becomes .deco/blocks with $componentKey rewritten to path-shaped keys, content types become page entries, and JSONC becomes TS scaffolds.

work_items.title: Define the loader-picker rule
work_items.plan: A field of type T accepts any block function that returns T (anyOf $refs). The CLI follows imported app maps with last-key-wins and warns on any.

work_items.title: Support typed block references
work_items.plan: BlockOf<'hero' | 'alert'> becomes an anyOf or Studio's legacy __SECTION_REF__. Also a Descriptor<P> marker, @singleton and @catalog false.

work_items.title: Specify the filename rule and ship a content bundle
work_items.plan: One decodeURIComponent per stem, with a collision report. deco content writes .deco/blocks.gen.ts, one import per JSON file, exporting the snapshot { revision, blocks } with the revision computed the same way the Deco API computes it, and computeRevision is exported.

work_items.title: Emit a runtime alias table
work_items.plan: The CLI emits an alias table that createCMS accepts, so list() and resolve() work through Content aliases.

work_items.title: Add a local dev loop
work_items.plan: deco schema --watch and deco content --watch run next to the framework's own dev server; there is no deco dev wrapper. Editing a JSON file hot-reloads through the framework's HMR, and only adding or removing a file needs deco content to regenerate. Still to build: a tunnel and a mounted Studio handler so Studio can edit a local checkout.

work_items.title: Ship the deco command
work_items.plan: These docs run npx deco schema, but no package declares a deco bin yet. Ship it from @decocms/blocks-cli, as Quickstart installs it, with its two commands, deco schema [--entry <path>] [--root <dir>] [--watch] [--check <base>] and deco content [--root <dir>] [--watch]. By default deco schema looks for the block map at blocks.ts or blocks.tsx in the project root or in src/; --entry overrides it. Add the other deco subcommands on this page to it.

work_items.title: Read manifest groups for pages, redirects, content and apps
work_items.plan: Support several page types, a content collection screen and singletons. Read flat redirect entries alongside the nested legacy shape, mapping type to permanent.

work_items.title: Use manifest lookup instead of path heuristics
work_items.plan: Replace the file-extension module-or-entry check and Studio's legacy '/sections/' path heuristics, and refuse to save an entry whose name is a manifest key.

work_items.title: Build the Deco API release service
work_items.plan: A release endpoint and site tokens (with a DECO_SITE_TOKEN lifecycle), rejection of ambiguous-route releases, and per-environment channels. The service serves every commit as it lands and doesn't compare schemas; compatibility is checked in CI by deco schema --check.

work_items.title: Align the preview protocol
work_items.plan: Send an empty __draft= (or keep 'off' as a documented contract) and force variants in the draft content. Keep gallery, global and in-place previews on /live/previews, which createStudioHandler serves, and include the draft grant in in-place renders, as the handler requires.

work_items.title: Drop legacy names from the Blog tab and experiments
work_items.plan: Detect the blog from the manifest, and stop keying experiments on the random matcher's entry name.

work_items.title: Label matchers from their schema and keep enum titles
work_items.plan: Label short-key matchers from their schema, dedupe aliased matchers, and keep oneOf const titles.

work_items.title: Add a per-page-type catalog and a page settings form
work_items.plan: Use the anyOf on a page type's sections list as Studio's catalog, and render the remaining page props as a form.

work_items.title: Bring Studio's SEO merge to parity with the kit
work_items.plan: Run Studio's mergeSeo (seo-editor.tsx) against the kit's mergeSiteSeo test suite, and decide whether descriptionTemplate applies.

work_items.title: Add a content-live signal
work_items.plan: Every response carries the served revision in x-deco-revision, and the CMS reports each revision it swaps in to the Deco API with the site token. Studio polls the API and shows a publish as pending until a report for its revision arrives, then live.

work_items.title: Update the injected agent rules
work_items.plan: Replace the two wrong rules for next-major sites. Content edits go only in .deco/blocks/<encodeURIComponent(key)>.json. Two files are generated and never edited by hand: .deco/schema.json, which deco schema rewrites after any change to a block's types, and .deco/blocks.gen.ts, which deco content writes and git ignores. A new type needs a block-map entry. remoteLoader picks up releases within about a minute, not on save, and with DECO_SITE_TOKEN set the dev server serves the API release, not local edits.

work_items.title: Resolve contradictions in these docs
work_items.plan:
• 'The CMS never sees Content' (Schema generation) vs list through aliases (API reference).

Also: make Page.seo optional, drop array elements that resolve to undefined (Studio's hidden array items), make a hidden block's undefined render nothing, say what a reference to a Content entry resolves to, and fix the credential sentence in Preview.

work_items.title: Correct Studio compatibility
work_items.plan: Studio compatibility now lists /live/_meta, /live/previews, /deco/invoke and /live/invoke. Add /.decofile and the secrets encrypt action, say how the new API mounts these endpoints, and state that sites allow framing through frame-ancestors, never X-Frame-Options, as the entry wrappers do.

work_items.title: Fix the TanStack guides
work_items.plan: Mount withDeco() instead of hand-wiring the draft cookie. Add validateSearch/loaderDeps and staleTime, and state that getRequest() is the RPC request on SPA navigation, so the page URL comes from the request scope.

work_items.title: Write the recipes that gate cutover
work_items.plan: Write these before the first site migrates: site-wide content and layout (header, footer, theme), site settings, 404/500, route params in blocks, per-shopper reads and actions as server functions (invoke → server fn), and regionalization cache keys.

work_items.title: Write the post-cutover recipes
work_items.plan: Page-level data shared by a page's blocks, client data fetching, server-only upstream proxies, overriding an app's block, tabs over pre-resolved data, head tags from blocks, locale, and robots/static SEO files.

work_items.title: Write a FastStore-to-Blocks guide
work_items.plan: Decision: port @faststore/core's UI components (FastStore calls them sections) into the site as vendored code, with no separate storefront UI kit; the commerce hooks they need come from apps-vtex. The guide covers the choice of App Router or TanStack Start (there's no Pages Router path), a core-internals → apps-vtex map, a fragment → loader map and the override → composition recipe.

work_items.title: Fix the Next guide
work_items.plan: Mount decoProxy() instead of wiring the draft cookie by hand. Wrap client() in cache(), map the full PageSeo and degrade SEO errors instead of throwing, make release routes ISR/static, and cover transpilePackages and outputFileTracingIncludes.

work_items.title: Write an operations page
work_items.plan: Five deliverables: (1) the DECO_SITE_TOKEN lifecycle (issue, rotate, scope) and a one-time warning when createCMS runs in production without a token; (2) a per-host table of how the SDK schedules its once-a-minute check on Workers, Node and Vercel; (3) default bounds for every in-isolate cache and how to change them; (4) the observability chokepoint rule (createInstrumentedFetch + createFetchCache) and the DECO_OTEL_* contract; (5) the 7.x → next env and binding table. Plus a CI job that resolves one block per app package in a Workers production build, to catch dynamic-import failures.

work_items.title: Add notes to the Rendering page
work_items.plan: Add four statements to Rendering. Inline <script> in a streamed boundary runs on parse, before the boundary is revealed, so use effects. <BlockList> keeps above-the-fold blocks eager, with sized skeletons below. UI stores (drawers, minicart) are app code, created per request. Request-scope values are read during resolve and passed as props, because AsyncLocalStorage is gone by the time a streamed boundary renders.

work_items.title: Fill in the schema reference details
work_items.plan: Unions to anyOf with const discriminators, intersections and recursion, type resolution through packages, filename-to-entry encoding, and how VariantOf<T> becomes one multivariate definition per T.

sites.name: TanStack storefront
sites.description: A storefront on TanStack Start and Cloudflare Workers, on the current @decocms 7.x packages.
sites.headline: Closest to the next major. Before it can move, the proposed API needs successors for the pieces it relies on today: the worker entry (the Workers request handler that wraps the app), the edge cache, the page-URL plumbing and the endpoints Studio calls.

steps.title: Fix dark metrics and /deco/invoke 404s
steps.text: createInstrumentedFetch('shopify') has no onComplete, so upstream metrics are dark. Site loaders called through /deco/invoke 404.

steps.title: Upgrade 7.20.7 to the latest 7.x
steps.text: The lockfile pins 7.20.7, which still sends X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and has no ?__draft binding. Moving past #390 (7.20.10) and #442 (7.34.0) lets Studio frame and preview the site today, and leaves one 7 → next step.

steps.title: Keep Studio's forms, previews and @options working after the move
steps.text: Next-major serves none of /live/_meta, /live/previews or /deco/invoke, and its schema file isn't what Studio reads. Forms, previews, @options fields and the Loaders tab all stop.

steps.title: Drop apps-shopify's @decocms/tanstack dependency and document its SDK imports
steps.text: It imports @decocms/blocks/sdk/{fetchTimeout,instrumentedFetch} and depends on @decocms/tanstack.

steps.title: Keep the edge cache and A/B split without createDecoWorkerEntry
steps.text: Workers Cache is on, with segment keys and degraded-page protection. The SITES_KV traffic split has no home.

steps.title: Keep the page URL on SPA navigation (PLP, search, PDP)
steps.text: Today's x-deco-page-url and derivePageUrl workarounds have no successor.

steps.title: Do the mechanical port
steps.text: Hand-write the block map (27 UI blocks, 12 loaders) with the path-shaped keys Studio needs, add the ~8-line requestToParam shim (app code), and replace Image/Picture (~20 files). The content fixes below register types into this map.

steps.title: Fix the content before cutover
steps.text: Rewrite the Category page path /* to /:collection, guard the PDP's seo: null and hoist SEO blocks out of sections[]. Register in the block map, or remove, ~20 unknown types, including the resolved built-in that Header.json's searchbar uses. Fix the Newsletter and Header drift, and hold MIGRATION_NEXT_STEPS' *Config Props regrouping until a content validator exists.

steps.title: Restore deferral and stop duplicate loads
steps.text: Its 43 Lazy wrappers (21 with inline loaders) lose deferral until Deferred<T> exists. 'PLP Loader' is referenced twice per page and needs the per-client memo.

sites.name: TanStack blog
sites.description: A blog on TanStack Start and Cloudflare Workers, on an older single-package version of the framework.
sites.headline: Simple content and a clean route tree, but it's on an older package: it upgrades to 7.x first (until then, Studio can't open it in its preview frame), and its Studio blog workflow depends on old loader names and apps-blog.

steps.title: Upgrade 6.12 to the latest 7.x first
steps.text: Fix upgrade-6-to-7 for the blog's specifiers (~45 symbols across 13 subpaths), then run it. That also drops X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and adds ?__draft, so Studio can frame the site. The move to next is then the same 7 → next step as the storefront's.

steps.title: Untie the Blog tab from legacy names and apps-blog
steps.text: It keys off blog/loaders/*.ts and @decocms/apps-blog ≥ 7.53.0, but the site is on @decocms/apps 5.2.0. Its meta sits at src/server/admin/meta.gen.json with Windows-path keys, and setInvokeLoaders exists only for Studio.

steps.title: Stop blog loaders reading the global decofile
steps.text: apps-blog's getRecordsByPath uses loadBlocks(), so under a pure CMS drafts read the wrong revision. It needs the request scope's client, or the lookups move to route code.

steps.title: Keep the live publish path
steps.text: regen-blocks.yml (Studio publish, then a regen commit, then a Workers Build) is how content ships today. Keep it until the release service and remoteLoader exist.

steps.title: Return real 404s for unknown URLs and stop routing /404 publicly
steps.text: The 7 pages form a valid trie, but unknown URLs are soft 200s via /:slug and /404 is publicly routable.

steps.title: Alias legacy types and render body blocks
steps.text: 25 legacy types (210 occurrences) need aliases, and body blocks become a Content-typed renderer.

steps.title: Handle images, the edge profile and app config
steps.text: The blog uses plain <img>, no edge profile fits posts, and app config goes through apps-blog.

steps.title: Two current bugs go away with the migration
steps.text: One is in the layout cache, the other in the build-time site-globals snapshot, which never reaches draft preview. The migration replaces both.

sites.name: Next.js storefront
sites.description: A Next.js storefront on another CMS. Not on Deco today, so this is a re-platform, not an upgrade.
sites.headline: A re-platform, not an upgrade. The target framework, the content, FastStore's native sections and the session model all come before the missing pieces in the proposed API even come into play.

steps.title: Pick the target framework and move to it
steps.text: Pick the target first: the App Router (the only guide; the Pages Router has none) or TanStack Start. It decides how FastStore's native sections get rebuilt. Its code imports @faststore/core internals, and most of its hook files, and the files that use its translation hook, lack 'use client'.

steps.title: Bring the content in from VTEX Headless CMS
steps.text: The content lives in VTEX Headless CMS. There's no Headless CMS-to-.deco/blocks importer, the JSONC schemas must become TS types, and per-page-type whitelists of allowed blocks and singletons have no TS or Studio expression.

steps.title: Rebuild what @faststore/core renders
steps.text: Its native sections (FastStore's UI components), including the stateful cart, search and session ones, the global ones (header, footer) and the 404/500 pages. No UI kit exists.

steps.title: Give apps-vtex session, region and delivery promise
steps.text: Without a populated request scope, regionalized Intelligent Search queries also silently fall back to the default region.

steps.title: Rewrite the data shapes to schema.org
steps.text: FastStore GraphQL moves to apps-commerce schema.org: the PDP view model, the product card, the BFF fields, tax prices and installments.

steps.title: Port client state and the core patches
steps.text: The useSearch state machine and the client fetches become server functions. The behaviours the core patches add are re-created as app code.

steps.title: Rename $componentKey values to path-shaped keys and avoid type-name collisions
steps.text: There's no legacy Deco content, so no legacy-type aliases. The importer must still rename $componentKey values (Navbar, Footer, Alert…) to path-shaped keys until Studio does manifest lookups, and avoid entry names that collide with type names. The Studio handler and schema fixes ({{item:roadmap-api--ship-the-studio-protocol-handler}}, {{item:roadmap-cli--write-a-studio-compatible-schema-file}}) gate editing.

categories.description: URL routing, page matching, route params, not-found handling, non-CMS routes, redirects and client navigation.

categories.title: UI blocks

categories.title: Data

categories.title: Commerce

categories.title: SEO

categories.title: Studio

categories.description: OTel and logging, upstream fetch instrumentation, analytics trackers and e-commerce events.

cms-page-routing.name: CMS pages matched by URL pattern
cms-page-routing.summary: Paths take only literal segments and single-segment params, so the storefront's `/*` Category page never matches. One Studio commit can make `matchRoute` throw on every request, and `Page.seo` is required while stored content holds `seo: null`.

home-route-override.name: Home route override (search params, page-URL header, client preload)
home-route-override.summary: The guide's `/$` route has no validateSearch or loaderDeps, and on `<Link>` navigation `getRequest()` returns the `/_serverFn/...` RPC URL, so search params and the page URL never reach blocks.

route-params-request-to-param.name: Route params bound via requestToParam
route-params-request-to-param.summary: The CMS never injects `match.params`, so every migrated site repeats the same ~8-line AsyncLocalStorage shim, and every `resolve()` must start inside it. The guides don't show it.

not-found-and-error-pages.name: Not-found and error pages
not-found-and-error-pages.summary: Only URL-level not-found works as documented. Unknown single-segment URLs match a template and stream as cacheable soft 200s, and there's no story for CMS-authored 404 and 500 pages.

non-cms-routes-and-account-pages.name: Code-only routes, account/login pages and external checkout
non-cms-routes-and-account-pages.summary: Code routes stay in the framework's router, so account and login pages are app code. After FastStore, `/pvt/account` falls into the CMS catch-all and 404s unless the account link points at the VTEX-hosted account.

router-and-client-navigation.name: Router setup, Link and client navigation
router-and-client-navigation.summary: `createDecoRouter` carries three behaviours these docs never mention: URLSearchParams search serializers, the CSP nonce, and scroll and intent defaults. The TanStack guide never appends the draft cookie, so preview is lost on the first in-frame `<Link>` click.

pwa-offline-static-assets.name: Offline page, service worker and public static assets
pwa-offline-static-assets.summary: Static assets are served before the CMS catch-all and `/offline` is an ordinary Route entry; registering `sw.js` and the web manifest takes about 3 lines. Any CSP must allow the Workbox import, and `/offline` must never be a draft render.

redirects.name: Redirects and route handlers
redirects.summary: `/old/*` globs are impossible with single-segment params, Studio's 307 has no counterpart (only 301 or 302), and query, case and duplicate-`from` handling are unspecified. A naive legacy alias doesn't match the nested shape Studio stores.

page-template-targeting.name: PDP/PLP templates targeted by product slug or category path
page-template-targeting.summary: The entries live in VTEX Headless CMS, so converting them to `.deco/blocks` comes first. There's no multi-segment catch-all, so category trees need one entry per depth, and [Routing](#routing) and [Router internals](#router-internals) disagree on when two templates are ambiguous.

block-type-discriminator.name: Block type naming (__resolveType / $componentKey)
block-type-discriminator.summary: Aliases are documented, but the filename-to-entry-name rule isn't (Studio writes every key through `encodeURIComponent`), Studio still classifies keys by their path shape, and an unregistered legacy type now fails its parent block with UNKNOWN_BLOCK.

global-layout-sections.name: Global/shared layout blocks (header, footer)
global-layout-sections.summary: Saved entries with references cover the two TanStack sites, but FastStore's global singletons have no equivalent. A layout and its page can get two clients on different revisions, and Lazy-wrapped headers and footers lose their deferral.

saved-loader-blocks.name: Saved loader blocks and commerce extension wrappers
saved-loader-blocks.summary: Per-request dedupe is only implied: no cache key, and nothing on shared in-flight promises. Pages that reference 'PLP Loader' or 'PDP Loader' twice would double their Shopify calls, and a failing loader now fails its whole block.

orphan-and-dangling-blocks.name: Unreferenced blocks and dangling references
orphan-and-dangling-blocks.summary: A dangling reference used to return null; now it fails the parent block, and one in `seo` throws. There's no validation tool, and one reading of the release rule would skip every storefront release because of ~20 unregistered types.

content-schema-drift.name: Content drift from current props / schemas
content-schema-drift.summary: Stored inputs pass through unvalidated, and no documented tool does the 'validate saved content' step. Drift is already live: the storefront's Newsletter content stores a flat shape its Props no longer read.

rich-text-html-props.name: Rich text / raw HTML props
rich-text-html-props.summary: Only `@format rich-text` is documented; `html`, `rich-text-inline`, `textarea`, `markdown`, alias-name detection and sanitization aren't, and FastStore's Lexical fields need converting.

nested-section-props.name: Block-typed props (nested blocks)
nested-section-props.summary: There's no documented way to type an input that takes a block so the CLI emits a block picker; today's schema uses Studio's legacy `__SECTION_REF__`. Nested blocks also resolve eagerly, with no Suspense boundary of their own.

key-prefix-content-collections.name: Content collections read by key-prefix scan
key-prefix-content-collections.summary: Block functions get no access to the content they're resolved against, so apps-blog's loaders, which read the global `loadBlocks()`, must be rewritten around a client the app provides. How `list()` learns Content aliases is unexplained.

denormalized-collection-references.name: Author/category collections with denormalized copies
denormalized-collection-references.summary: The in-memory join is trivial for 4 authors and 5 categories, but it depends on the same unsolved client access as key-prefix collections. A real reference to a Content-only entry would fail with UNKNOWN_BLOCK.

post-body-block-renderer.name: Nested post-body blocks rendered by a site map
post-body-block-renderer.summary: Listing posts with `run: true`, or resolving one, turns every body block into UNKNOWN_BLOCK and fails the post; registering the types as functions loses the TOC's raw input. Rendering the stored blocks from a site-owned map works.

per-page-section-whitelists.name: Per-page-type block whitelists
per-page-section-whitelists.summary: A page's sections list can't be typed as a subset of block types, because `Block` is untyped. Studio's add-section catalog (its legacy name) is the union of all UI blocks anyway, so a narrowed schema wouldn't restrict it.

page-level-settings-fields.name: Page-level settings outside the block list
page-level-settings-fields.summary: Studio edits only a page's name, path, SEO and block list, so typed page settings get no form. Only one page type can carry the `website/pages/Page.tsx` alias.

cms-navigation-menus.name: CMS-authored navigation and menus
cms-navigation-menus.summary: A block that references a Content-typed menu entry fails with UNKNOWN_BLOCK, which contradicts the advice to declare navigation in Content. Nothing says whether `deco schema` handles the intersections and recursion in `SiteNavigationElement`.

conditional-schema-fields.name: Discriminated-union fields (dependencies + oneOf)
conditional-schema-fields.summary: Union handling isn't documented, so this relies on today's generator carrying over (literals to const, object unions to anyOf). JSON Schema `dependencies` has no TS form, and the array constraint tags aren't listed.

editor-widgets-and-image-fields.name: Editor widgets and image/media fields
editor-widgets-and-image-fields.summary: Image and HTML fields depend on type-alias names these docs never mention. If `deco schema` drops alias detection, all 22 image pickers and the HTML editors become plain text inputs, and the widget vocabulary isn't listed.

icon-by-name-enums.name: Icon-by-name enums and code-embedded logo
icon-by-name-enums.summary: Union-to-enum, `@format` passthrough and widget tags aren't documented, so icon and image fields may degrade to text, and enum display labels can't be expressed. The content must first be exported from VTEX.

matchers-and-variants.name: Matchers, variants and personalization
matchers-and-variants.summary: Every variant resolves, so a block Studio hides with a never rule still runs its loaders, and its `undefined` renders 'temporarily unavailable'. Device and random matchers no longer ship, and which Studio matcher paths get aliases is unstated.

per-path-section-visibility.name: Per-path block visibility
per-path-section-visibility.summary: This is component logic. A server-side check in a Next layout won't re-evaluate on client navigation, and `router.asPath` includes the query string, so compare pathnames.

device-detection-and-targeting.name: Device detection and device targeting
device-detection-and-targeting.summary: Detection is app code, but device as a cache-key dimension, hydration of request-derived values and Studio's device and variant preview are unaddressed. Studio's variant tabs can't force a variant through an app-owned multivariate.

section-registration-conventions.name: UI block registration and file conventions
section-registration-conventions.summary: Registration works, but none of the 8 legacy convention flags or section loaders has a home, so each site rebuilds the ~737-line DecoPageRenderer. There's no descriptor type, and `getRequest()` gives URL-dependent loaders the wrong URL on SPA navigation.

section-catalog.name: Block catalog exposed to editors (Studio's section catalog)
section-catalog.summary: The catalog works for legacy path-keyed (site/sections/…) blocks, but thumbnails and in-place render go through `/live/previews`, which these docs don't define. The alias bridge skips Lazy and the Seo* types, and a JSX type can't be kept out of the catalog.

native-section-overrides.name: Overrides of platform-native components
native-section-overrides.summary: Overrides collapse into plain composition, but the core components, contexts and SDK hooks they rely on must be rebuilt. There's no page-level data context, and keys like 'Footer' can collide with saved-entry names.

native-platform-sections.name: Native platform components used via schema only
native-platform-sections.summary: Nothing in the next major renders UI without site code, and UI stays out of `@decocms/apps`. Replacing the core components, the stateful ones included, is real engineering, and FastStore's global-section (its term) and 404/500 content types have no layout pattern.

code-composed-pdp.name: Code-composed monolithic PDP block
code-composed-pdp.summary: The block-function part works, but a PDP block has no documented way to get route params, and it can't signal a 404 once a template route matches. Its view model also parses FastStore GraphQL shapes.

product-card.name: Product card organism and CMS card config
product-card.summary: Server-side product inputs and typed card config work as documented, but apps-vtex has no tax-inclusive prices, full installment ladders or delivery badges, and a Content-typed card-config entry nested in a block fails with UNKNOWN_BLOCK.

lazy-deferred-sections.name: Lazy / deferred / viewport-gated blocks
lazy-deferred-sections.summary: A legacy Lazy wrapper's `section` input resolves fully before Lazy runs, so Lazy defers nothing (43 wrappers on the storefront). Viewport-gated second hops need a revision the client doesn't expose, and today's per-prop deferral has no counterpart.

section-loaders.name: Prop-enrichment loaders (legacy section loaders)
section-loaders.summary: The documented request sources don't give blocks the page URL: on TanStack SPA navigation `getRequest()` returns the `/_serverFn` URL, Next's `headers()` has none, and `match.params` has no path to blocks or app packages.

tabbed-shelf-partial.name: Tabbed shelf / server partial re-render
tabbed-shelf-partial.summary: Client-side tabs over pre-resolved data are one `useState`. Fetching only the active tab would need a server partial re-render and a re-resolve at a pinned revision, which the proposed API lacks.

inline-loader-props.name: Loaders and query descriptors in block props
inline-loader-props.summary: There's no page-URL or search-param injection, blocks get no client (so apps-blog reads the wrong revision in preview), and both the rule for which loaders a field accepts and the memo key are unspecified. 21 of the storefront's inline loaders sit inside Lazy wrappers.

app-loader-overrides.name: Site overrides of app/platform loaders
app-loader-overrides.summary: Overriding a key is plain JS, but none of the 3 real overrides ports on the proposed API alone. There's no notion of app packages, and no rule says whose schema wins when a site overrides an app's key.

site-local-loaders.name: Site-local loaders called from the client
site-local-loaders.summary: No framework feature is needed, and the migration fixes a live bug: `/deco/invoke` never finds the site's user and wishlist loaders, so those calls 404 and throw. They become server functions.

invoke-and-actions.name: Actions, invoke endpoint and client invoke
invoke-and-actions.summary: There's no invoke endpoint, and [Studio compatibility](#studio) is wrong: Studio calls `/deco/invoke` for @options fields, Run and the product picker, and `/live/invoke` to encrypt secrets.

bff-custom-endpoints.name: BFF: custom GraphQL fields proxying platform REST
bff-custom-endpoints.summary: Nothing framework-level is needed; API routes belong to the framework. Each handler sets Cache-Control itself once `@cacheControl` goes.

implicit-page-data-context.name: Route page data via page context
implicit-page-data-context.summary: Routing and looking entries up by name is allowed, but the provider data moves from FastStore fragments to schema.org types. Server block functions can't read client React context, so sharing one fetch needs React cache or an app-owned AsyncLocalStorage.

plp-filters-sort-pagination.name: PLP/search filters, sort and pagination
plp-filters-sort-pagination.summary: On SPA navigation blocks see the RPC URL, `/*` never matches, and without loaderDeps the loader doesn't re-run. Show-more needs `/deco/invoke` and a revision, the Lax draft cookie is rejected in Studio's iframe, and FastStore's search state machine must be rebuilt.

site-search-and-autocomplete.name: Site search and autocomplete
site-search-and-autocomplete.summary: Nothing matches `Resolved<T>`: Suggestions keeps its loader unresolved and invokes it with `query`, which an eagerly resolved inline block can't do. `resolved` isn't in the alias bridge, and apps-shopify has no suggestions loader.

graphql-fragments-codegen.name: FastStore GraphQL fragment overrides and codegen
graphql-fragments-codegen.summary: FastStore tooling with no counterpart once @faststore/api and core are gone. Persisted-query hashes acted as an allowlist, so each replacement server function needs explicit input validation.

graphql-schema-extensions.name: GraphQL schema extensions on product/offer
graphql-schema-extensions.summary: A wrapper block can compute the fields, but apps-vtex's lean offers drop the full installment list and interest rates that custom price fields may need. The BFF's per-field cache policy must be restated per server function.

vtex-io-app-settings.name: Merchandising data from VTEX IO app settings
vtex-io-app-settings.summary: A server endpoint plus a client hook, but apps-vtex has no persisted-query client for `/_v/public/graphql/v1`, so the site's IO client still needs porting, and it's unclear what the app should cache with.

commerce-platform-binding.name: Commerce platform binding
commerce-platform-binding.summary: Loaders as block functions and legacy aliases are documented, but not what apps need from the runtime: apps-* import `@decocms/blocks/sdk/*` and depend on `@decocms/tanstack`, and no guide populates `RequestContext`, so apps-vtex's region and cookies silently turn off.

shopify-autoconfig-workaround.name: Shopify app autoconfig static-module workaround
shopify-autoconfig-workaround.summary: There's no registry left to patch. The package bug is still open and its root cause was never established, so in-body dynamic imports need checking in a production Workers build.

cart-customer-server-functions.name: Cart and customer via server functions
cart-customer-server-functions.summary: The four cart server functions touch neither the CMS nor `/deco/invoke`. They break at import time, though, if apps-shopify's `@decocms/blocks/sdk` imports and its `@decocms/tanstack` dependency don't survive.

client-commerce-state-hooks.name: Client commerce state hooks and SSR prefetch
client-commerce-state-hooks.summary: The hooks and their SSR prefetch stay app code.

cart-and-minicart.name: Add to cart, minicart and checkout handoff
cart-and-minicart.summary: The proposed API has no cart; the Next guide's CartButton is a counter demo. The invoke-based cart is TanStack-only, the VTEX checkout proxy lives in `createDecoWorkerEntry`, and FastStore's cart rules must be rebuilt by hand.

session-regionalization.name: Session and regionalization
session-regionalization.summary: There's nothing on sessions or regions beyond cache-key advice. Without a populated `RequestContext`, apps-vtex's regionalized Intelligent Search queries silently fall back to the default region.

delivery-promise.name: Delivery-promise facets and region slider
delivery-promise.summary: Neither these docs nor apps-vtex have it: the Intelligent Search loaders carry no delivery-promise parameters, and the FastStore hooks and region slider it uses don't survive. It also depends on session regionalization.

global-ui-state-store.name: Global UI state store
global-ui-state-store.summary: Shared open/close state is plain React context. A module-level store must never be written during SSR, and the cart sidebar and region slider that lived in @faststore/core become site code.

newsletter-subscription.name: Newsletter subscription
newsletter-subscription.summary: A form plus a server function or Server Action is a few lines. The content drift (flat fields where Props read nested `notices` and `form`) means editors' copy is ignored today, and the public POST needs rate limiting.

product-comparison.name: Product comparison
product-comparison.summary: One server function plus useQuery; the selection context moves unchanged. The cost is re-platforming the comparison sidebar to schema.org products, and it can't ship before ProductGallery's search state is rebuilt.

shipping-simulation.name: PDP shipping simulation
shipping-simulation.summary: It becomes a server function around an existing apps-vtex call. Every `invoke.*` call site needs rewriting, and without `RequestContext` no segment cookie is forwarded, so regional SLAs can differ.

wishlist-notify-reviews.name: Wishlist, notify-me, reviews (stubbed)
wishlist-notify-reviews.summary: These are placeholders; each becomes a server function in a few lines. The site's demo wishlist code uses `RequestContext`.

interactive-ui-widgets.name: Client UI widgets (sliders, drawers, modals, scripts)
interactive-ui-widgets.summary: Plain-React widgets run unchanged, but the storefront's widgets import `@decocms/blocks/sdk/useDevice` and the Image and Picture hooks, the CSP nonce comes from `createDecoRouter`, and the blog's inline scripts misbehave in streamed boundaries.

design-system-library.name: Site-owned atomic UI library
design-system-library.summary: The app owns this entirely. Hook-using files without `'use client'` throw under Server Components, and the FastStore shell's contexts must be re-mounted.

page-seo-blocks.name: Page-level SEO blocks
page-seo-blocks.summary: `page.seo` resolves, but the guides map only title and description, so canonical, robots, OG and page JSON-LD have no owner. The blog's SEO blocks need cross-entry lookups, and `throw seoError` turns an upstream failure into a full-page error.

site-seo-defaults.name: Site-wide SEO defaults and title templates
site-seo-defaults.summary: There's no site-level SEO concept, so inheritance is app code and must match Studio's `mergeSeo` exactly. Studio's preview applies titleTemplate but not descriptionTemplate, so production and preview already differ.

commerce-seo-sections-in-sections.name: Commerce SEO blocks inside a page's block list
commerce-seo-sections-in-sections.summary: The target, `page.seo`, is documented; what's missing is the SEO-hoist codemod and the per-client memo-key rule. The problem is live today: storefront PDP and PLP heads carry only the site title.

head-tags-from-sections.name: Head tags injected from blocks
head-tags-from-sections.summary: React 19 hoisting lets a block emit head tags, but the per-block Suspense pattern defeats in-block LCP preloads, and nothing says so. Preload from the page component instead.

json-ld-structured-data.name: JSON-LD structured data
json-ld-structured-data.summary: The JSON-LD helpers live in `@decocms/blocks/hooks`, which has no documented home in a React-free SDK, and the proposed API has no `<JsonLd>` renderer.

sitemap.name: Sitemap
sitemap.summary: Only literal pages and Route-typed content are handled: templated pages have no enumeration story, and there's no XML or sitemap-index helper. Next's `app/sitemap.ts` is static by default, which defeats remote releases.

robots-and-static-seo-files.name: robots.txt, llms.txt and favicons
robots-and-static-seo-files.summary: Static files sit outside the CMS, so these are content fixes: the storefront's robots.txt has no Sitemap line, the blog's Sitemap URL is relative, and FastStore must recreate its robots.txt and favicon.

edge-html-cache-profiles.name: Edge/HTTP cache profiles
edge-html-cache-profiles.summary: There's no HTTP or edge cache story, and the Next pattern disables static and ISR rendering. Degraded pages get cached, and there's no revision to key by. The planned once-a-minute check makes content consistent within about a minute.

in-isolate-caches.name: In-process caches (layout, loaders, globals)
in-isolate-caches.summary: Cross-request caching is 'your policy', and the SWR and dedup utilities apps and telemetry depend on aren't on the documented surface. Draft caches are unbounded, input-keyed caches miss request state, and Studio's bypass flag is ignored.

request-context-cookies.name: Request context, cookies and headers
request-context-cookies.summary: Headers and cookies are available, but the page URL and params, Set-Cookie from resolution and the request port apps-* use are not. [Block maps](#manifest) says to read route params through `getRequest()`, which is wrong even on SSR.

admin-protocol-endpoints.name: Admin/Studio protocol endpoints
admin-protocol-endpoints.summary: Nothing serves the endpoints Studio calls (`/live/_meta`, `/.decofile`, `/live/previews`, `/deco/invoke`), and Studio's code contradicts [Studio compatibility](#studio). Invoke is needed in production too, for the blog's product picker.

studio-preview.name: Studio preview rendering
studio-preview.summary: Draft rendering maps directly, but the TanStack guides never append the draft cookie, the SameSite=Lax cookie is rejected in Studio's iframe, and there's no no-store rule for drafts. Recovering `data-manifest-key` takes more than a wrapper.

studio-schema-generation.name: Editor schema generation / catalog
studio-schema-generation.summary: The CLI's documented output isn't what Studio reads: the file name, btoa keys, `schema.root` unions and `schema.definitions` all differ. There are no `apps` or `actions` groups, and the promised JSDoc tag table doesn't exist.

cms-schema-upload-pipeline.name: CMS schema generate and upload (VTEX CP)
cms-schema-upload-pipeline.summary: The VTEX upload has no counterpart, because publishing is committing. The replacement inherits the schema-file problems.

studio-workspace-spaces.name: Studio workspace layout (spaces.json)
studio-workspace-spaces.summary: Nothing in Studio reads `spaces.json`. What matters instead: Studio's Blog tab keys off legacy blog loader names and gates scheduling on `@decocms/apps-blog` 7.53.0 or later, while the blog pins `@decocms/apps` 5.2.0.

dev-studio-content-loop.name: Local dev daemon and Studio content loop
dev-studio-content-loop.summary: With a token in dev, `remoteLoader` swaps in the production release over local edits, so Studio sandbox saves vanish from the dev preview. Nothing regenerates the schema or serves the Local-mode endpoints.

site-bootstrap.name: Site bootstrap (createSiteSetup + admin setup)
site-bootstrap.summary: `createCMS` plus a block map replace registration, but nothing generates the map (27 UI blocks and 12 loaders by hand on the storefront), the revision of generated content must match the API hash (planned: deco content computes it the same way), and there's no lenient mode or Studio-shaped schema.

site-config-block.name: Site config block / global settings
site-config-block.summary: Today the binding resolves the site's theme, globals and page blocks into every page. In the next major, SEO-default merging and global-block injection move to app code, there's no singleton concept, and `site/apps/site.ts` isn't in the alias bridge.

app-installation-and-store-config.name: App installation blocks, autoconfig and store config
app-installation-and-store-config.summary: There's no concept of an app: no config for app loaders, no autoconfig, no secret resolution, no `apps` manifest group and no encrypt endpoint, so Studio can't save secret fields.

env-vars-and-secrets.name: Environment variables and secrets
env-vars-and-secrets.summary: DECO_SITE_TOKEN's lifecycle is undocumented, there's no channel option, and a production deploy that forgets the token silently serves bundled content. There's no secret story either: the decryptor for secrets stored in content is off the documented surface.

build-time-site-globals-snapshot.name: Build-time site-globals snapshot workaround
build-time-site-globals-snapshot.summary: A workaround for a current-framework bug, with nothing to port. Half its call sites are server-side, so the site needs a small AsyncLocalStorage hand-off, and the snapshot's defect (edits never reach draft preview) goes away.

app-domain-types.name: App domain types driving Studio schema
app-domain-types.summary: The mechanism is documented but not the conventions apps-blog relies on: type-alias formats like `ImageWidget`, and `@titleBy`, `@hide` and `@widget`. Without them the blog's forms degrade to plain text inputs.

worker-server-entry.name: Worker/server entry composition
worker-server-entry.summary: Only the CMS and draft slice of the entry is documented. Studio routes, the edge cache, purge, security headers and OTel have no home, the draft cookie is SameSite=Lax, and `?__draft=off` never exits preview.

csp-security-headers.name: CSP and security headers
csp-security-headers.summary: Headers are a few lines of app code, but after migration nothing sets HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy or a framing policy, and the origins Studio needs in frame-ancestors are undocumented.

ab-traffic-split.name: Migration A/B traffic split
ab-traffic-split.summary: Nothing gives `withABTesting` a home, and it isn't few-line app code. It also needs to bypass draft requests by default.

hosting-and-deploy-config.name: Hosting and deploy configuration
hosting-and-deploy-config.summary: Only the single-instance happy path is documented: a cron or webhook `update()` refreshes one instance, serverless Node gives no staleness bound, and per-PR preview deploys swap in the production release.

content-storage-and-delivery.name: Content storage, snapshot and delivery
content-storage-and-delivery.summary: The file model matches, but filename encoding, bundling, the release service and skew protection are unspecified. Compatibility between content and the deployed code is meant to be checked in CI by `deco schema --check`, which isn't built yet.

fast-deploy-kv.name: Fast Deploy (KV-first content)
fast-deploy-kv.summary: `remoteLoader` will check once a minute (configurable with `interval`), cold isolates serve the deployed content module until their first check, a webhook reaches one isolate, and the first-party `kvLoader` is still to ship. Impact on these sites is low: none serves content from KV today.

ci-and-release-workflows.name: CI, content regen and release workflows
ci-and-release-workflows.summary: The CI job is a few lines, but the CLI doesn't emit what Studio reads and has no `--check` mode. The blog's `regen-blocks.yml` is its live content-delivery path today; deleting it early freezes its content.

root-document-layout.name: Root document and layout
root-document-layout.summary: The document shell is app code, but the Studio bridge and the `section[data-manifest-key]` marker it needs are neither shipped nor documented. Dropping the DECO.events bootstrap also silently breaks OneDollarStats.

codegen-pipeline.name: Codegen and build pipeline
codegen-pipeline.summary: `deco schema` and a hand-written block map replace the registries, `deco content` (planned) generates the content module for every runtime, but there's no `--check` compatibility check yet, and Content aliases can't work at runtime.

bundler-config.name: Vite config
bundler-config.summary: The guide configs build, but nothing replaces decoVitePlugin's dev and Studio duties: schema regeneration, the Studio tunnel, the build hash and block preloads. Next also needs transpilePackages and file-tracing notes.

faststore-cli-overlay.name: FastStore CLI .faststore overlay
faststore-cli-overlay.summary: The overlay goes away by design, but the move off it has no guide, no content importer and no serverless deployment note. Everything the overlay supplied becomes app code, and its imports of core internals, `@faststore/core` and `@generated` have to go.

framework-import-surface.name: Framework import surface and compat shims
framework-import-surface.summary: These docs cover about 12 CMS-core symbols and say nothing about the 7.x sdk, hooks, admin or binding tiers that apps-* and the telemetry depend on. Widget aliases are missing, and there's no 7.x to next codemod.

core-patches.name: patch-package patches to core
core-patches.summary: The patches go away, but the behaviours they add must be re-created in site code.

dev-tooling-and-repo-hygiene.name: Dev tooling, quality gates and repo hygiene
dev-tooling-and-repo-hygiene.summary: Ordinary app work, and the CI drift check is one line, but there's no `--check` mode or content validator. Sites' own lint and quality scripts carry over as app scripts.

legacy-runtime-leftovers.name: Legacy Deno/Fresh leftovers
legacy-runtime-leftovers.summary: Dead Deno and Fresh files, with nothing to port.

e2e-lighthouse-config.name: E2E and Lighthouse config
e2e-lighthouse-config.summary: Tests are the app's job. A 'resolve every page' smoke test needs a fake request context, and there's no framework harness, so every site writes the same test.

ai-agent-instructions.name: AI-agent instructions
ai-agent-instructions.summary: Agent docs are repo content, but no canonical guidance ships, and Studio's injected rules drift from the next major.

workspace-packages.name: Sites and block types in workspace packages
workspace-packages.summary: Undocumented: whether `deco schema` follows block types into a workspace or npm package, and how the Deco API and Studio address a site that lives in a package inside a larger repository.

theming-and-styling.name: Theming and styling
theming-and-styling.summary: There's no pattern for site-wide content resolved outside the catch-all, so the theme streams late under Suspense and shifts the layout, and the theme and the page can come from different revisions.

web-fonts.name: Web fonts
web-fonts.summary: `googleFonts` has no home in the next-major packages and imports `sdk/fetchTimeout`. Making fonts editable also needs the CLI to link `font: Font` to loaders by return type, a rule these docs name but never define.

image-optimization.name: Image optimization
image-optimization.summary: Images aren't mentioned. Without a shipped URL builder, migrated sites serve full-size originals and ignore Studio's quality choice, and without `format: image-uri` Studio shows a text box instead of the image picker.

i18n-and-currency.name: i18n and currency
i18n-and-currency.summary: Locale is fixed per deployment, so the only framework need is cache keys. In the FastStore storefront, code that calls its own translation hook without `'use client'` throws as a Server Component until it's rewritten.

otel-observability.name: OTel and logging
otel-observability.summary: The tracing obligation is stated, but the app gets no seam to meet it: request telemetry is locked in `createDecoWorkerEntry`, `remoteLoader` fails silently, and spans around JSX blocks miss the upstream fetches.

upstream-fetch-instrumentation.name: Upstream fetch instrumentation
upstream-fetch-instrumentation.summary: The storefront calls `createInstrumentedFetch('shopify')` with no onComplete, so upstream metrics are dark today. The chokepoint rule is never stated, and there's no meter on Next or Node.

analytics-trackers.name: Analytics trackers
analytics-trackers.summary: Trackers carry over, but the DECO.events bootstrap is private and copied three times, and experiment results break: Studio keys them on the random matcher's saved-entry name, which a pure block function never sees.

ecommerce-analytics-events.name: E-commerce events
ecommerce-analytics-events.summary: Emitters are app code, but the receiving pipeline is mounted only by the bindings' DecoRootLayout, which the guides don't use, so every commerce event would drop silently.
